comments: Input facts: ego is the car responder; agent1 is the pedestrian initiator; the pedestrian remains within the trafficway, stationary or moving parallel without crossing. Chosen assumptions: The pedestrian initiates the conflict by walking toward ego along the same lane, parallel to the roadway in the opposite direction. Ego travels forward and brakes as separation decreases. The schema crossing value denotes longitudinal walking only, with no roadway crossing. Distances are meters, speeds meters per second, reaction delay seconds, and brake/throttle controls dimensionless. The pedestrian conflict begins at time zero. These realizations create conflict opportunities; no collision outcome is imposed.
